# Rescale and Honda Expand Strategic Partnership to Accelerate Product Development


Honda recently made the strategic decision to expand the partnership to establish a modern, flexible engineering foundation that can support future technological advancements across physics simulation, engineering, and product development.


“The demands on our engineering environment are only growing, with more complexity, faster cycles, and the need to explore more possibilities earlier in development,” said Tomoaki Utsunomiya, chief engineer, Auto. Dev. Engineering Systems (TE), HM ECM System Div, Digital Unit, Honda Motor Co., Ltd. “Rescale gives us the flexibility and scale to meet those demands as they evolve. As we look ahead, having a platform that can continuously strengthen our engineering capabilities as technology advances is exactly what we need.”


[Read the Full Story →](https://rescale.com/news/honda-expands-strategic-partnership-rescale-accelerate-product-development/?utm_source=email&utm_medium=marketo&utm_campaign=newsletter&utm_content=q3&utm_term=)

Innovation Corner


Agentic Engineering for Computational Chemistry


In this demo, an agent takes on a lysozyme solvation study, moving beyond automating and troubleshooting GROMACS runs to diagnosing methodological confounds, debating experimental design against scientific intent, and configuring the right simulations so researchers can focus on the science.
